unitTitle: Subject/Object Personal Pronouns - The verb 'to be' - Have got - Can - Present Simple - Present Continuous

pairsWith.noteUz: Bu nazariya beti Coursebook 1-unit grammatikasini yakunlaydi: Present Simple imlo, talaffuz, ishlatilishi; Present Continuous; ikkalasining farqi.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 1-UNIT NAZARIYA, 3-BET (6-bet, PDF 5). Yuqorida chapda ko'k '1'. Och pushti ramka, ikki ustun.

CHAP USTUN:
'Spelling: 3rd person singular, affirmative': • Most verbs take -s in the third person singular. 'I sit - he sits' • Verbs ending in -ss, -sh, -ch, -x or -o take -es. 'I kiss - he kisses, I wish - he wishes, I go - he goes' • Verbs ending in a consonant + y drop -y and take -ies. 'I fly - he flies' • Verbs ending in a vowel + y take -s. 'I say - he says'
'Use': We use the present simple for: • daily routines, habits or repeated actions. 'We start work at 9 o'clock every morning. (daily routine) I play football in my free time. (habit)' • permanent states. 'He lives in Madrid.'
'Pronunciation': -s or -es in the third person singular is pronounced: • /s/ with verbs ending in /f/, /k/, /p/ or /t/ sounds. 'he sits' • /ɪz/ with verbs ending in /s/, /ʃ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/ or /z/ sounds. 'he watches' • /z/ with verbs ending in all other sounds. 'he runs'
'Time expressions we use with the present simple': every hour/day/week/month/summer/year etc, usually, always, every morning/evening/afternoon/night, in the morning/evening/night, at night, etc.
'Present Continuous (to be + verb -ing)' jadvali: Affirmative: I'm working, you're working, he's working, she's working, it's working, we're working, you're working, they're working. Interrogative: Am I working? Are you working? Is he working? Is she working? Is it working? Are we working? Are you working? Are they working? Negative: I'm not working, you aren't working, he isn't working, she isn't working, it isn't working, we aren't working, you aren't working, they aren't working.

O'NG USTUN:
'Form': • We form the present continuous with the verb "to be" and add -ing to the base form of the main verb.
'Use': We use the present continuous for: • actions happening now, at the moment of speaking. 'I'm reading a magazine now.' • actions happening around the time of speaking. 'She's studying for the final exams.' • fixed arrangements in the near future. 'They're flying to Tokyo next week.'
'Time expressions we use with the present continuous': now, at the moment, these days, at present, tonight etc.
'Short answers': Are you/they ...? - Yes, I am./Yes, we/they are. No, I'm not./No, we/they aren't. Is he/she/it ...? - Yes, he/she/it is. No, he/she/it isn't. • In short answers we use "Yes" or "No", the subject pronoun and the verb "to be" in the correct form. We do not repeat the main verb with the -ing.
'Present Continuous vs. Present Simple': We use the present continuous for: • actions happening now. 'Tom is cooking dinner at the moment.' • actions happening around the time of speaking. 'She's studying hard these days.' We use the present simple for: • daily routines or habits. 'Mary goes to work by train.' • permanent states. 'Mrs Morris works as a secretary.'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '6'.

exercises.instructionEn: Spelling: 3rd person singular, affirmative. Most verbs take -s: I sit - he sits. Verbs ending in -ss, -sh, -ch, -x or -o take -es: I kiss - he kisses, I wish - he wishes, I go - he goes. Verbs ending in a consonant + y drop -y and take -ies: I fly - he flies. Verbs ending in a vowel + y take -s: I say - he says.
exercises.instructionUz: Imlo: 3-shaxs birlik, tasdiq. Ko'p fe'llar -s oladi: I sit - he sits. -ss, -sh, -ch, -x yoki -o bilan tugaydigan fe'llar -es oladi: I kiss - he kisses, I wish - he wishes, I go - he goes. Undosh + y bilan tugaydiganlar -y ni tashlab -ies oladi: I fly - he flies. Unli + y bilan tugaydiganlar -s oladi: I say - he says.
exercises.explanationUz:
3-ShAXS BIRLIK IMLOSI - 4 QOIDA.

  1) KO'PChILIK: + -s
     sit → sits, work → works

  2) -ss, -sh, -ch, -x, -o: + -es
     kiss → kisses
     wish → wishes
     watch → watches
     fix → fixes
     go → goes, do → does

  3) UNDOSh + y: -y → -ies
     fly → flies
     study → studies
     try → tries

  4) UNLI + y: + -s (o'zgarmaydi)
     say → says
     play → plays
     enjoy → enjoys


⚠ 'HAVE' → 'HAS' (istisno).

points.en: Most verbs take -s: I sit - he sits
-ss, -sh, -ch, -x, -o → -es: he kisses, he wishes, he goes
consonant + y → -ies: I fly - he flies
vowel + y → -s: I say - he says

exercises.instructionEn: Pronunciation: -s or -es in the third person singular is pronounced /s/ with verbs ending in /f/, /k/, /p/ or /t/ sounds (he sits); /ɪz/ with verbs ending in /s/, /ʃ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/ or /z/ sounds (he watches); /z/ with verbs ending in all other sounds (he runs).
exercises.instructionUz: Talaffuz: 3-shaxs birlikdagi -s yoki -es /s/ deb o'qiladi - /f/, /k/, /p/, /t/ tovushlari bilan tugaydigan fe'llarda (he sits); /ɪz/ - /s/, /ʃ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/, /z/ bilan tugaydiganlarda (he watches); /z/ - qolgan barcha tovushlarda (he runs).
exercises.explanationUz:
-S / -ES TALAFFUZI - 3 XIL.

  /s/ - JARANGSIZ undoshdan keyin
    (/f/, /k/, /p/, /t/):
    sits, works, stops, laughs

  /ɪz/ - ShIVIRLOVChI tovushdan
    keyin (/s/, /ʃ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/,
    /z/):
    watches, kisses, wishes,
    changes - QO'ShIMChA BO'G'IN

  /z/ - QOLGAN HAMMA (jarangli
    undosh va unlilar):
    runs, plays, goes, lives


⚠ 'watches' - IKKI bo'g'in
  /wɒtʃɪz/; 'sits' - BIR bo'g'in.

points.en: /s/ after /f/, /k/, /p/, /t/: he sits
/ɪz/ after /s/, /ʃ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/, /z/: he watches
/z/ after all other sounds: he runs

exercises.instructionEn: Affirmative: I'm working, you're / we're / they're working, he's / she's / it's working. Interrogative: Am I working? Are you working? Is he working? Negative: I'm not working, you aren't working, he isn't working. Form: We form the present continuous with the verb 'to be' and add -ing to the base form of the main verb. Use: actions happening now, at the moment of speaking: I'm reading a magazine now; actions happening around the time of speaking: She's studying for the final exams; fixed arrangements in the near future: They're flying to Tokyo next week. Time expressions: now, at the moment, these days, at present, tonight etc. Short answers: Are you working? - Yes, I am. / No, I'm not. Is he working? - Yes, he is. / No, he isn't. We do not repeat the main verb with the -ing.
exercises.instructionUz: Tasdiq: I'm working, you're / we're / they're working, he's / she's / it's working. So'roq: Am I working? Are you working? Is he working? Inkor: I'm not working, you aren't working, he isn't working. Shakl: 'to be' fe'li + asosiy fe'lga -ing. Ishlatilishi: hozir, gapirish paytida bo'layotgan harakat: Men hozir jurnal o'qiyapman; gapirish davrida bo'layotgan harakat: U yakuniy imtihonlarga tayyorlanyapti; yaqin kelajakdagi aniq reja: Ular keyingi hafta Tokioga uchishadi. Vaqt ifodalari: now, at the moment, these days, at present, tonight. Qisqa javob: Are you working? - Yes, I am. / No, I'm not. Asosiy fe'l (-ing) takrorlanmaydi.

QAChON:

  1) HOZIR, ShU PAYTDA:

  2) ShU KUNLARDA (aynan hozir

     She's studying for the final
     exams.
  3) YAQIN KELAJAKDAGI ANIQ REJA:

VAQT SO'ZLARI:

  now, at the moment, these days,
  at present, tonight


QISQA JAVOB:

  Are you working?
    Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
  Is he working?

  ⚠ 'Yes, I am working' ✗ - -ing
  fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI.

sections.title: Present Continuous vs. Present Simple
sections.titleUz: Present Continuous va Present Simple farqi

exercises.instructionEn: We use the present continuous for actions happening now (Tom is cooking dinner at the moment) and actions happening around the time of speaking (She's studying hard these days). We use the present simple for daily routines or habits (Mary goes to work by train) and permanent states (Mrs Morris works as a secretary).
exercises.instructionUz: Present continuous - hozir bo'layotgan harakatlar (Tom hozir kechki ovqat pishiryapti) va gapirish davrida bo'layotgan harakatlar (U shu kunlarda qattiq o'qiyapti) uchun. Present simple - kundalik tartib yoki odat (Meri ishga poyezdda boradi) va doimiy holatlar (Morris xonim kotiba bo'lib ishlaydi) uchun.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI ZAMONNI SOLIShTIRISh.

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS:
  • HOZIR: Tom IS COOKING dinner
    at the moment.
  • ShU KUNLARDA: She'S STUDYING
    hard these days.

  PRESENT SIMPLE:
  • ODAT / TARTIB: Mary GOES to
    work by train.
  • DOIMIY HOLAT: Mrs Morris WORKS
    as a secretary.


⚠ O'ZBEKChADA HAM FARQ BOR:

  'pishirYAPti' (hozir) ↔
  'pishirADI' (odatda)
  is cooking ↔ cooks


⚠ KALIT SO'ZLAR:

  now, at the moment, these days
    → Continuous
  every day, usually, always
    → Simple

points.en: Tom is cooking dinner at the moment. (now)
She's studying hard these days. (around the time of speaking)
points.uz: U shu kunlarda qattiq o'qiyapti. (shu davrda)

points.en: Mary goes to work by train. (daily routine / habit)
Mrs Morris works as a secretary. (permanent state)
points.uz: Morris xonim kotiba bo'lib ishlaydi. (doimiy holat)

patterns.formula: KIM + FE'L(s) + every day / usually (Present Simple)
patterns.exampleEn: We start work at 9 o'clock every morning. Mary goes to work by train.
patterns.exampleUz: Biz har kuni ertalab 9 da ishni boshlaymiz. Meri ishga poyezdda boradi.

patterns.formula: KIM + am/is/are + FE'L-ing + now / at the moment (Present Continuous)
patterns.exampleEn: I'm reading a magazine now. Tom is cooking dinner at the moment.
patterns.exampleUz: Men hozir jurnal o'qiyapman. Tom hozir kechki ovqat pishiryapti.

patterns.formula: KIM + am/is/are + FE'L-ing + next week (aniq reja)
patterns.exampleEn: They're flying to Tokyo next week.
